repos_data.description: Mac lyrics app: word-by-word synced lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou and more. Floating desktop lyrics, notch / Dynamic Island, menu bar and Touch Bar; translation, romanization, Last.fm scrobbling, Discord. Open-source LyricsX alternative. | Mac 桌面歌词：QQ音乐、网易云、酷狗、洛雪音乐逐字歌词，灵动岛、翻译、粤拼，LyricsX 替代
